children: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Monday that some social programs could eventually cease to be mandatory expenditures, a move he said would give policymakers greater flexibility in managing the federal budget.

Durigan said at an event hosted by BTG Pactual that placing certain programs under what the government calls "flow control," such as the Bolsa Familia cash-transfer program, would create incentives for policymakers to improve program oversight and beneficiary screening.
